title: Agent Lifecycle Record Response (Route 5)
description: ALR-1105 Route 5 response (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:754-791): GET .../agent-lifecycle/agent-revisions/{agent_revision_ref}/record. This document is closed (additionalProperties:false) with exactly the fourteen top-level properties below -- it has no legacy_claims property (guard-killing mutation row 8, corpus case record_response_legacy_claims_property_rejected, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1051/:1146) and deliberately has no qualification, standing, permit, invalidation, decision, or release/release.state field anywhere (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:789, :1465 Owner decision card 2 Option A): record truth and product availability have different producers, and release posture is not a lifecycle-record field in Part 1. Route 5 performs no legacy-claim join; the pre-existing legacy CERTIFIED_SELECTION wire (certified_selection_schema.json) is untouched by this document and remains visibly legacy/client-attested/non-authorizing on its own surface (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:116, :898, :965) -- this schema does not reference it and never maps it onto lifecycle Qualification or Standing. governance_profile/identity_state/measurement_coverage/comparability_verdict are $ref'd directly from agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json's individually $ref-able axis definitions (never duplicated); ArtifactVersionSlot.state is checked separately from identity_state as Part 1 const UNKNOWN (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1140) via the four named binding slots below. Integration note: StableOpaqueRef/TypedOpaqueRef/OpaqueRefId/EpisodeMeasurementCoverage/AgentLifecycleRecordRef are defined LOCALLY in this document's definitions because this branch was cut before Routes 1-4's schemas (which mint the canonical shared copies per ALR-1102/ALR-1103) landed here; the shapes below intentionally mirror those routes' definitions byte-for-byte so a later integration pass can delete the local copies and repoint these $refs at the shared originals without a shape change. x-disclosure {rule,artifact} annotations below anticipate the versioned client-boundary disclosure register (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:376-403, row 17, not yet embedded in agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json on this branch) and are assigned per its published rule vocabulary and exact-override manifest (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:404-408, :434-438); they are metadata only and carry no runtime validation effect. Coverage is complete for every property this document declares directly; annotating the internals of $ref'd agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json axis definitions is left to the story that extends that shared file (out of this packet's write scope).

schema_version.description: Closed public wire-version discriminator (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:272, :764); never a product/version claim.

record_ref.description: Minted by Route 1 for live registration or by the bounded historical backfill under the same issuance invariants; never minted by this read route (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:765).

agent_ref.description: Stable logical longitudinal subject, no version_id (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:766).

agent_revision_ref.description: Exact immutable revision at the record center (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:767).

created_at.description: Initial Backend record issuance time; immutable (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:768).

as_of.description: The single Backend read-snapshot time this entire response was derived against -- every episode state and coverage field is computed relative to this one value, not re-queried per field (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:769, :877).

governance_profile.description: Exactly OBSERVED/backend_observed/[]; no Part 1 action authority (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:770).

identity_state.description: One exact live/legacy tuple from the orthogonal-axis table; never inferred from another axis (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:771). Row 2 guard: this axis vocabulary is structurally separate from ExperimentGroup's identified/unidentified grouping vocabulary in execution/experiment_group_schema.json -- see tests/test_agent_lifecycle_contract.py::test_identity_vocabularies_are_structurally_separate (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1140).

measurement_coverage.description: Selected under the exact ordered predicates in the coverage inventory: newest live seal uses basis=LATEST_SEALED_EVIDENCE_EPISODE; otherwise a bound private marker uses UNKNOWN_LEGACY_BASIS; otherwise the appropriate no-evidence basis is used (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:772, :879).

pending_episode.description: The newest episode that is ISSUED at as_of, or null if none exists. An episode EXPIRED at as_of never appears here, only in evidence_episodes (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:773).

bindings.description: Immutable projections of real live Bindings only. No legacy/null-contract branch exists. A marker-backed record with no live protocol activity returns [] (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:775).

evidence_episodes.description: Chronological real live episodes only; historical markers never appear in this array (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:776).

rescorability.description: The same newest live SEALED reconciliation selected for top-level measurement_coverage, projected as the Route 4 aggregate; if no live seal exists (including marker-driven UNKNOWN) this is exactly {state:unknown,trust_level:client_attested,authority_effect:NONE} (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:777).

OpaqueRefId.description: Not a name, digest, tenant id, or content-derived public capability (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:285, :294-295). Mirrors the canonical shape Route 3 defines once (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:626-660 area); local copy pending integration, see top-level description.

StableOpaqueRef.description: Names a longitudinal, non-versioned resource that outlives any single snapshot of it (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:280). Has no version_id field at all -- additionalProperties:false rejects one (corpus case typed_ref_stable_kind_includes_version_id, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:287).

kind.description: Full Part 1 TypedOpaqueRef kind vocabulary (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:293), including reserved kinds with no Part 1 producer; each use site further constrains this to its exact kind. Route 5 never emits a ref whose kind is qualification/standing/decision/dependency/invalidation -- no property on this document's root uses any of those consts.

version_id.description: Identifies one immutable version; never latest (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:295). version_id==id is required for every immutable-snapshot kind in this beta contract (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:299), but that cross-field equality is service_invalid, not schema-decidable, per the same contract paragraph.

TypedOpaqueRef.description: Content-free object naming one immutable, once-minted snapshot (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:289).

AgentLifecycleRecordRef.description: The lifecycle record's own opaque handle (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:434-437, :490): kind receives the ordinary exact-vocabulary assignment, while id/version_id receive the record-handle disclosure override distinct from a generic TypedOpaqueRef -- both public record_ref fields (Route 1's response and this one) reference this same shape.

state.description: Schema const UNKNOWN on every Part 1 public slot; a reserved verified value is a later schema version with no Part 1 producer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:306). Checked independently of identity_state (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1140).

ref.description: Schema const null on every Part 1 public slot; a non-null ref is forbidden to every Part 1 route and consumer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:307).

ArtifactVersionSlotBase.description: The public projection of the existing fp2 ArtifactVersion, not a second digest definition (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:301-309). Base shape narrowed per named slot below; no public property name contains the forbidden config-space-fingerprint substring.

measurement_contract_ref.description: Non-null; the live-only closed item requires a typed non-null contract ref (corpus case record_live_binding_projects_null_measurement_contract_ref, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1066).

governance_scope_ref.description: Minted in the same Route 3 transaction that mints the Binding; governance_scope has no independent public producer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:652).

BindingProjection.description: Every closed item requires origin=const LIVE and exactly the four named slots (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:775, corpus case binding_all_four_version_slots_with_unknowns).

EpisodeMeasurementCoverage.description: Used only by evidence_episodes[].measurement_coverage; exactly the live sealed shape (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:743). Distinct from (not a duplicate of) agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json's RecordMeasurementCoverage, which is reserved for this document's top-level field only: a sealed episode always produces real accounting, so state is restricted to COMPLETE|PARTIAL (never UNMEASURED/UNKNOWN) and basis is fixed to SEALED_EVIDENCE_EPISODE (never LATEST_SEALED_EVIDENCE_EPISODE, corpus case coverage_seal_response_wrong_basis, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1063). Per the 2026-08-09 owner accounting decision (runs/agent-lifecycle-contract-integration/OWNER_DECISION_ACCOUNTING_20260809.md, Option A): no ninth accounting field, and duplicate is schema-const 0 on every branch.

reason_codes.description: COMPLETE carries no caveat unless the underlying contract is client-attested: exactly [] or [CLIENT_ATTESTED_ONLY].
PARTIAL always carries INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE_EPISODE, optionally alongside CLIENT_ATTESTED_ONLY.

experiment_run_ref.description: Optional; present only when Route 3 accepted the optional same-scope provenance ref. Lifecycle emits existing provenance but does not mint/version it (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:776).

state.description: Derived at the single as_of snapshot (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:779-786); an unrecognized value is invalid (corpus case episode_unknown_state_value).

expires_at.description: Required non-null RFC 3339 timestamp; every public episode is live and requires one (corpus case episode_live_origin_null_expires_at, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1067).

sealed_at.description: Optional; present only on a SEALED episode.

measurement_coverage.description: Required and non-null only for SEALED; null for ISSUED|EXPIRED (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:776, corpus case episode_measurement_coverage_present_for_unsealed_state). Narrowed by the sibling if/then below.

PendingEpisodeProjection.description: {run_plan_ref,binding_ref,issued_at,expires_at,state} for the newest episode that is ISSUED at as_of; null if no such episode exists (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:773).

trust_level.description: Always client_attested regardless of aggregate state; never elevated (corpus case record_client_rescorability_raises_authority).

authority_effect.description: Always NONE regardless of aggregate state.

RescorabilityProjection.description: Route 4's aggregate for the same newest live SEALED reconciliation selected for top-level measurement_coverage; the fixed no-live-seal default is {state:unknown,trust_level:client_attested,authority_effect:NONE} (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:777, corpus case record_client_rescorability_no_authority).
